item.title: Corner of Winchester Avenue and Willesden Lane, 2nd August
item.description:
Repeated dumping of clothing and other items outside clothes bank container. Visible rat in the debris. This is a repeated issue of flytipping and this container needs to be removed. There is no reason to have this here and now vermin are using it likely for nesting. It is a health hazard for humans and dogs. No reason to retain this container. People can donate directly to charity shops. It is aesthetically dreadful and is now being used as a dumping spot repeatedly. I have submitted photos in the past and never received a response re what is being done to stop this. Will request local councillors also involved now.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Dyne Road, London
Report on FixMyStreet
